text: dsh-web-search-brave 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Brave Search 网页搜索提供器：它接入 DSH 的 web 能力并注册搜索提供器，将查询发送到 Brave Search Web API，再把标题、摘要、链接和可识别的发布日期映射为 DSH 搜索结果。它支持安全搜索级别、结果数量、清洁摘要和请求超时设置，并可响应调用方取消。适合希望让 DSH 使用 Brave 网页搜索的用户；使用前需要配置 Brave API 密钥。

This DSH plugin uses Brave Search for web queries. It registers a search provider, sends queries to Brave's API, and returns links, titles, snippets, and dates. It supports Safe Search, result limits, clean snippets, and timeouts. A Brave API key is required.

dsh-web-search-brave 的功能「Brave 网页搜索」：将 DSH 的搜索查询发送至 Brave Search API，并把有效链接、标题和摘要转换为统一搜索来源。DSH 发起 web 搜索时自动调用。
dsh-web-search-brave 的功能「发布日期映射」：将结果中的可解析 page_age 或 age 字符串转换为 publishedAt 字段；优先读取 page_age，遇到非日期格式则不写入日期。
dsh-web-search-brave 的功能「搜索选项」：可配置安全搜索级别、结果数量与摘要装饰，并按查询参数传给搜索服务；默认关闭文本高亮装饰，返回条数默认 10。
dsh-web-search-brave 的功能「凭据与超时处理」：从 DSH 凭据服务或启动环境解析 Brave 密钥，并为搜索请求设置超时；缺失密钥、请求失败和超时会返回带类型的 Web 错误。
dsh-web-search-brave 使用 Brave 搜索需要 BRAVE_API_KEY；密钥可从 DSH 凭据服务或启动环境读取，搜索请求会发送到 api.search.brave.com。
dsh-web-search-brave README · dsh-web-search-brave：

dsh-web-search-brave README · dsh-web-search-brave：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [Brave Search](https://api.search.brave.com)-backed search provider for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web capability seam (`ctx.web`): it makes the built-in `web_search` tool run on Brave's Search Web API instead of the shipped DeepSeek route.

**DSH compatibility:** validated with `0.2.0-rc.2`.

dsh-web-search-brave README · Features：- **Clean snippets** - `text_decorations` defaults to false so snippets stay free of `<b>` highlight markers.
- **Dates** - `page_age` (ISO 8601) maps to the seam's `publishedAt`; human-readable `age` is ignored.
- **Keyed only** - Brave has no keyless mode; free tier: 2,000 queries/month at [api.search.brave.com](https://api.search.brave.com).

dsh-web-search-brave README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-search-brave
```

Set your API key in DSH's credential store (recommended) or export it in the environment that starts `dsh web`:

```yaml

dsh-web-search-brave README · ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml：BRAVE_API_KEY: BSA...
```

Select the provider (the bundle patch does this automatically; to switch manually):

```yaml

dsh-web-search-brave README · your profile's cordis.patch.yml：- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: brave
```
